node.title: M720 over-ceiling complete-window certificates
node.statement: The two over-ceiling n=32,h=16 complete-window cells at q~n^2 and q~n^3 have complete certificates with zero unpaid non-toral active-core count, or a corrected certificate policy excludes them from complete-cell use.
